_note: Every component here but Kept.svelte has a template the Svelte compiler's parse() rejects (duplicate attribute, text directive value, <svelte:element> without this, {@html} in an attribute value, {@debug} of a member, {@render} of a non-call, {@const} sequence, unknown {@tag}, duplicate and nested <svelte:window>/<svelte:body>, invalid <svelte:options> values, empty {}, an unparsable snippet parameter list, a reserved-word shorthand, an unknown block). svelte-check converts each component with svelte2tsx, which calls parse(); when it throws, the component leaves the run, so its script's type error is never reported. Only Kept.svelte's is. Verified against svelte-check --tsgo with svelte 5.55.
